purpose: Pre-registration freeze for C4 selection rule v4 (acid-OFF). Written BEFORE scoring.

rule.greedy: by S, recompute D and N per seat

candidate_source_manifest.pool_definition: 342 designs with a recomputed apical L6 record (results/c4_linkage_apical_20261025/linkage_apical.json records)

available_model_inventory.note: Every design has exactly ONE original human apical complex prediction (Boltz-2, chain B = 195-residue P02786 189-383). No design has a second original complex model, so 'all available models' == one model and 'minimum over available models' is not a min-5.

mouse_models.coverage: the 20 incumbent acid-ON seats ONLY; 0 of the v4 acid-OFF eligible set

novelty_screen.control_status: strict search gave zero hits in all four DBs; validated by a positive control in the same run (real swissprot sequences self-hit at fident 1.000)

second_ph_estimator.consequence_for_P: P=0.5 requires a CONTROLLED second estimator. This file has no recorded controls, so it cannot by itself grant P=0.5.

available_model_inventory.gpu: none used; no folding engine in this stack accepts pH as input
